facts.text: Students in unlimited-license maritime majors participate in the Regiment of Midshipmen and complete training cruises at sea aboard the 500-foot Training Ship State of Maine.

sources.title: Regimental Program - Student Life - Maine Maritime Academy
sources.quote: As an unlimited license major in Marine Engineering Operations, Marine Engineering Technology, Marine Systems Engineering (5-year track), and Marine Transportation Operations, you'll complete a 37-day summer training program at sea on the Training Ship State of Maine (TSSOM).
